note: Hand-derived RFC-13 binary protocol conformance oracle. The accepted case completes both projected endpoints; every reject case names the structured protocol error that must be present.

accept.name: binary_dual_completion
accept.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { c.send(1); c.receive(); } fn b(c: P::B) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { c.receive(); c.send(2); }

reject.name: wrong_role
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn b(c: P::B) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { c.send(1); }

reject.name: payload_mismatch
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { c.send(true); c.receive(); }

reject.name: endpoint_duplication
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { let copied = c; c.send(1); c.receive(); }

reject.name: endpoint_abandonment
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { }

reject.name: invalid_repeat_exit
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, repeat | end } fn b(c: P::B) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { c.receive(); c.send(2); c.end(); }

reject.name: missing_blocks_effect
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A) -> () ! pure requires true ensures true { c.send(1); c.receive(); }

reject.name: shared_endpoint
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } shared channel: P::A

reject.name: multiparty_deferred
reject.program: protocol P { A { x: u32 }, B { y: u32 }, C { z: u32 }, end }

reject.name: branch_path_witness_deferred
reject.program: protocol P { A { request: u32 }, B { response: u64 }, end } fn a(c: P::A, choose: bool) -> () ! blocks requires true ensures true { if choose { c.send(1); } else { c.send(2); } c.receive(); }
